import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def task_func(country_dict):
    countries = list(country_dict.keys())
    gdp_values = np.random.randint(
        1_000_000_000,
        100_000_000_001,
        size=len(countries),
        dtype=np.int64,
    )
    return pd.DataFrame({"GDP": gdp_values}, index=countries)
